meta.title: RepoChan — CHARACTER FILE
meta.description: The character file of RepoChan: a 16-year-old freelance illustrator and owner of studio Sugar Riff. Profile, design index, double life, a day-to-night world, voice lines and fun facts — produced by the RepoChan persona pipeline.

hero.kicker: 16-YEAR-OLD DIGITAL ARTIST · OWNER OF SUGAR RIFF
hero.nameEn: R E P O C H A N

catch.text: A quiet first-year high schooler by the window all day — until the last bell rings, and she becomes an illustrator followed by hundreds of thousands.

side.text: 放課後のイラストレーター —

hero.charAlt: Full-body portrait of RepoChan: silver hair, heterochromia, cat-ear hair clip, oversized band hoodie, big headphones around her neck

heading.line2: like a detective who just cracked the case.

paragraphs.t: RepoChan is the kind of girl who pulls you into her creative excitement the moment she opens her mouth. With a detective's curiosity, she pieces together a
from scattered clues: the first three chords of a band's demo, the tone of a repo's README, a VTuber's catchphrase — noise to everyone else, a whole person to her.
At school she's a bona fide prodigy — half-listens in class and still ranks top three, homework finished before the last bell, because
every minute after school belongs to Sugar Riff
. Her classmates only know a quiet girl with good grades and a slightly odd cat-ear hair clip; none of them know that the girl by the window is "RepoChan", followed online by hundreds of thousands.
But she has the honest flaws of a 16-year-old: the moment inspiration hits, her desk becomes a battlefield; overexcited, she once sent a client an unfinished draft and withdrew it blushing —
And her sense of direction is roughly zero: she can take three wrong turns walking from the subway to her own studio.

quote.text: "Drawing and rock 'n' roll are the same thing — you smash whatever's inside you straight out."
quote.caption: MOTTO — REPOCHAN'S CREED

visual.alt: RepoChan at her desk: stylus in hand, big headphones on

panels.alt: A classroom by day: RepoChan in uniform by the window
panels.t2: The quiet honor student by the window
panels.t3: Uniform tidy, homework done at school, top three without trying. Nobody knows where she goes after class — "Sugar Riff? What's that?" She smiles: a friend's place.
Blazer tossed onto the guitar amp, hoodie on, headphones on, volume up — the world shrinks to pen and rock. A secret identity is, after all, pretty rock 'n' roll.

items.name: Cat-Ear Hair Clip
items.desc: Spotted at a corner store in middle school, bought simply because it was cute, worn for years since. Her visual signature — "no reason, I just like it."

items.name: Star Cursor Earring
items.desc: A gift she bought herself after her first open-source commission at 14, worn on the left ear. "First paycheck had to buy something cool."

items.name: Stylus Pendant
items.desc: A mini stylus pendant from a fan. When the drawing won't come, she grips it without noticing — an artist's lucky charm.

items.name: Over-Ear Headphones
items.desc: Her barrier field. Hundreds of songs in the library, a dedicated BGM playlist for every commission. Deadline mode: punk.

world.title: World
world.subtitle: WORLD — SUGAR RIFF, DAY & NIGHT
world.intro: A tiny studio on the corner of a creative district, a crooked fluorescent-pink marker sticker on the door reading "Sugar Riff" — she refuses to rewrite it. Scroll to stay from an after-school afternoon all the way into deadline night.
world.labelNight: DEADLINE NIGHT — Sugar Riff after dark
world.imgDayAlt: Sugar Riff in the afternoon: sunlight slanting across the desk
world.imgNightAlt: Sugar Riff late at night: one warm lamp above the desk

capDay.text: Afternoon sun slants across the desk — stylus in one hand, a half-eaten sandwich in the other. Her school blazer rests on the guitar amp in the corner; outside, someone walks a dog and a tram hums by. Quiet, warm, and all hers.

capNight.text: Only one warm lamp burns above the desk. A few empty cola cans have piled up, the turntable spins an old record, the cat-ear clip sits slightly crooked — she hasn't noticed, because "this solo is insane, ten more minutes."

sub.t: One iron rule for commissions: if she doesn't feel it, she won't take it. Any quote, any client — one off-key brief and it's a straight pass.
"Draw something you don't feel, and the lines die."

voice.jp: ノット・フィーリング、ノット・ドローイング
marquee: Got your soul, loud and clear
Look — this one just talked to me

cards.title: The heterochromia is circle lenses
cards.desc: A whole drawer of lenses in different colors; blue + violet-pink is the daily signature combo — "but on Halloween I go full black."

cards.title: Her styluses are named after rockers
cards.desc: The daily driver is called Freddie; the inking pen is Kurt. Every pen has its own band and its own job.

cards.title: The door sign stays crooked
cards.desc: The fluorescent-pink marker lettering on Sugar Riff's door is slightly crooked, but she refuses to rewrite it — "the first take has the most soul."

cards.title: Wrong song, meaner drawing
cards.desc: Switching bands to match the art style is muscle memory. Once, mid-cover for a gentle light novel, she accidentally queued Metallica — "the whole piece came out ready to fight."

cards.title: Mini zines of behind-the-scenes brain storms
cards.desc: She binds favorite recent commissions and behind-the-scenes ideas into mini zines. The fridge never runs out of iced cola — "sugar and fizz are the twin engines of a deadline."

special.title: "Soul Sketch" & "BGM Match"
special.desc: She can name the song and band within the first three chords of anything, and sketch a character impression from someone's social profile in three minutes. She calls it — "the ability to have a conversation with it."

footer.tagline: Sugar is sweet. Riff is loud. So am I.
